>
[Artisinal Crafter](/Feats.aspx?ID=5361) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Minotaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=788" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 42

</column>

---

Like many minotaurs, you take pride in creating items made from stone or metal. You become trained in [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37) (or another skill of your choice, if you're already trained in Crafting) and gain the [Specialty Crafting](/Feats.aspx?ID=5216) skill feat in your choice of blacksmithing, leatherworking, or stonemasonry.
